subject: Contract renewal + scaled expansion proposal for Stonebridge
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@stonebridge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Contract renewal + scaled expansion proposal for Stonebridge

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion I pulled together a compact proposal that keeps your unit economics intact as you scale into the fall. High level: Stonebridge renews for a 12-month term, we add a staggered commit band for the new catalog ingestion workload, and we include a mid-term pricing anchor to protect you from transient spot-price variance.

Attached: SOW_Stonebridge_Q3_v2.pdf and a short forecast template (stonebridge-usage-forecast.xlsx) so your procurement team can populate PO timing.

Proposal summary (starter view):
- Base renewal term: 12 months, existing effective rates preserved for the current commit volume.
- New scale band: +30% commit starting month 2; discount ladder on incremental units (3 tiers).
- Elastic true-up: quarterly true-ups with a small banded rebate for predictable growth (up to 10% buffer).
- Mid-term anchor: if public cloud GPU pricing drops materially, we will cap price decreases to protect your committed discount continuity (you can invoke reprice review at quarter boundaries).

Ask from your side:
1) Can procurement share expected PO date range and whether you need invoice timing shifted to align with fiscal quarter close?
2) Can you confirm the incremental monthly token estimate for the catalog-onboarding run?

If that looks directionally good I can loop in Finance (cc'd Lauren) and Ops (David) to finalize the concession table and attachments for signature.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0171

Attachments: SOW_Stonebridge_Q3_v2.pdf (pdf), stonebridge-usage-forecast.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@stonebridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@stonebridge.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal + scaled expansion proposal for Stonebridge

Karthik —

Appreciate the crisp summary and the SOW. A few clarifications from our side before we route to procurement: 

1) Forecast: We expect a jump in catalog ingestion and embeddings-heavy traffic starting Sept 15. Ballpark incremental monthly tokens = 1.2B (we'll upload the filled forecast by EOD tomorrow).

2) Discount ask: To make the expansion greenlit, our CFO is requesting a steeper discount on the incremental band (we're asking for an additional 5% off the incremental tier vs your initial ladder).

3) Invoice timing: Procurement prefers a single annual PO, invoiced at renewal effective date. If Redwood needs to stagger invoices for accounting, we need the total annual amount locked and a clear invoice schedule.

4) SLA & ramp credits: If we exceed the committed burst pool in month 2, we want a temporary burst credit to avoid overage shock while we hit steady-state.

We can run a short procurement call on Wed if that helps.

Thanks —
Maria Gomez
Head of Platform Ops, Stonebridge Retail
maria.gomez@stonebridge.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal + scaled expansion proposal for Stonebridge — internal pricing note

Karthik / David —

Thanks — saw Maria's asks. Quick internal note on what we can do without legal redlines:

Concession outline (internal proposal):
- Incremental band discount: baseline ladder + 3% on tier 1, +5% on tier 2, +7% on tier 3. We can make the top band take a further 2% if they sign a 24-month staged commit instead of 12.
- One-time ramp credit: offer a single-month buffer credit equal to 10% of overage for month 1 after the expansion (to address their burst concern).
- Invoice schedule: allow annual PO but split invoicing into 2 equal invoices (renewal effective date and 6 months later) for cashflow alignment — this satisfies finance while giving procurement a predictable schedule.
- Elastic true-up: keep quarterly true-ups; cap downside reprice protections to be review-only (no retro refunds).

Ops asks for quote: David, can you validate the burst pool sizing and confirm the delta between steady-state and peak? Need that number to size the ramp credit.

Once we have the burst numbers, I can create a concession table and margin impact calc for approval. If margin compression > 8% we escalate to revenue ops.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Sales Finance Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Contract renewal + scaled expansion proposal for Stonebridge — counter & next steps

Hi Maria / Procurement team —

Thanks for the clarity and the forecast submission this morning — I reviewed the filled numbers and looped Finance + Ops through the burst sizing. Here's a concise counter that addresses your CFO's ask while protecting our margin band: 

Final offer summary:
- Term: 12 months (option to convert to 24-month staged commit for a deeper top-band discount).
- Incremental band discounts: +4% tier 1, +6% tier 2, +8% tier 3 on incremental usage (this is 1% higher than Lauren's baseline to move the deal).
- Ramp credit: one-time buffer credit covering 12% of month-1 overage charges (applies only if overage occurs during first 60 days post expansion).
- Invoice schedule: Accept single PO but split invoices into two draughts (renewal effective date and 6 months later). Total annual amount fixed in the agreement.
- Ops: scheduled a dry-run for the migration week of Sept 6 — we will reserve a 20% burst pool the first two weeks after go-live.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm PO target date so we can align the DocuSign timeline.
2) If OK, I will push this version to DocuSign; contracting will include a short amendment that documents the ramp credit and invoice schedule.

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/stonebridge/Envelope12345
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/9327/record/STONE-3421

If procurement wants a 30-minute review call, I can schedule for Thursday morning.

Best,
Karthik
